tests.description: [Software Acceptance] Verify that all required core modules import cleanly without missing third-party packages.
[Software Acceptance] Verify nuclear auxiliary heat-exchanger geometric and physical constants.
[Software Acceptance] Verify that execution relies strictly on pre-installed scientific packages without external tools.
[Software Acceptance] Verify physical file structure in target workspace.
[Software Acceptance] Verify that synthetic generator outputs exactly 8,760 hourly records and all required columns.
[Model Quality] Verify realistic seasonal ambient intake water temperature dynamics.
[Model Quality] Verify mesophilic biological growth response peaks in 25-32°C and ceases at cold/hot extremes.
[Model Quality] Verify that biofilm growth honors lag-induction phase and physical thickness limits.
[Model Quality] Verify that pressure drop is derived from continuum fluid mechanics (Darcy-Weisbach + Haaland) without hardcoded exponents.
[Model Quality] Verify thermal fouling resistance Rf = delta_f / k_biofilm and degraded heat transfer coefficient.
[Model Quality] Verify that Biofouling Severity Index (BSI) produces a normalized score between 0 and 100.
[Model Quality] Verify that simulated sensor measurements exhibit non-zero variance around physical trajectories.
[Model Quality] Verify strict chronological train/validation/test partitioning with zero temporal overlap.
[Model Quality] Verify that feature scalers and transformers are fit strictly on training data.
[Model Quality] Verify that baseline model (Ridge / EWMA) trains and predicts future fouling resistance.
[Model Quality] Verify that improved ML model (Random Forest / GBDT) achieves lower MAE/RMSE than baseline on multi-step horizon.
[Model Quality] Verify that triggering a cleaning event causes immediate drop in biofilm thickness and pressure drop.
[Model Quality] Verify that Condition-Based Optimization achieves lower total operational cost than fixed calendar cleaning.
[Model Quality] Verify that increasing cleaning intervention cost correctly reduces cleaning frequency in condition-based optimizer.
[Model Quality] Verify excess pumping power calculation based on differential pressure surge.
[Model Quality] Verify that equivalent CO2 emissions scale linearly with excess energy and grid carbon intensity.
[Model Quality] Verify tracking of cumulative chemical biocide mass and environmental compliance status.
[Software Acceptance] Verify that local HTTP server serves dashboard and JSON API endpoints without crashing.
[Software Acceptance] Verify that dashboard HTML contains native SVG or Canvas chart containers for zero-install plotting.
[Software Acceptance] Verify that setting a fixed random seed produces bitwise-identical synthetic data.
